answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The wander holds work receipts rather than names, so the walnut of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
